title: TripAdvisor Restaurant Reviews

restaurantNames.title: Restaurant names
restaurantNames.description: Restaurant or attraction names, ideally with the city, e.g. ["Cervejaria Ramiro, Lisbon", "Oceanário de Lisboa"]. Use for "reviews of restaurant X". Resolved through TripAdvisor's own typeahead; a hit must share at least half of your words, so a name TripAdvisor does not know ends as a free error row, never as a random bistro — check location_name and location_type in the location and status rows. Empty (default) = none; one of restaurantNames, startUrls or locationIds is required.
restaurantNames.sectionDescription: Restaurant or attraction names, TripAdvisor URLs and/or location ids (the d<number> in a URL). At least one; a URL, its id and its name are read and billed once.

startUrls.title: TripAdvisor restaurant or attraction URLs
startUrls.description: TripAdvisor restaurant or attraction pages on any country site, e.g. ["https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g189158-d2703366-Reviews-Cervejaria_Ramiro-Lisbon.html"] or an Attraction_Review URL; ShowUserReviews deep links work too. Only the numeric d<id> matters. Hotel URLs are refused before anything is charged (use kestrel/tripadvisor-reviews-scraper). Empty (default) = none.

locationIds.title: TripAdvisor location ids
locationIds.description: TripAdvisor location ids, the number after "d" in a restaurant or attraction URL, e.g. ["2703366", "d190147"] — what an earlier run's location_id gives you. The fastest path (no lookup) and the way to re-read the same places on a schedule; TripAdvisor resolves whether the id is a restaurant or an attraction. A hotel id ends as status wrong_type and an unknown id as not_found, both free. Empty (default) = none.

locationType.title: Location type
locationType.description: "any" (default) = restaurants and attractions. "restaurant" or "attraction" = only that family: a target of the other family is reported as status wrong_type after one page and never charged. Hotels are wrong_type whatever you choose. Use "restaurant" when the user says "restaurants only".

maxReviewsPerLocation.title: Max reviews per location and language
maxReviewsPerLocation.description: The main cost control: the newest N reviews per location and language are read, e.g. 50 (default 100, maximum 20000), at most N × $0.005 ($0.50 at the default). 0 = every review the site lists (15 per page on restaurants, 10 on attractions; busy places run into the thousands). Filters apply AFTER this cap: 100 with maxRating 2 delivers only the low-rated reviews among the newest 100, so pair a filter with 0 or with sinceDate when the user wants all of them.
maxReviewsPerLocation.sectionDescription: How many reviews per location and language, and which ones. TripAdvisor lists reviews newest first; every filter here runs before billing, after the maxReviewsPerLocation cap.

sinceDate.title: Only reviews published on or after
sinceDate.description: Only reviews published on or after this date: "2026-06-01", or relative so a schedule never goes stale: "30 days", "2 weeks", "6 months". Reviews come newest first, so reading stops once a whole page is older — a daily run with "2 days" reads one or two pages per restaurant and bills only the new reviews. Empty (default) = no date limit. Use for "new reviews only" and review monitoring.

maxRating.title: Only reviews at or below this rating
maxRating.description: 0 (default) = every rating. 1-5 = keep only reviews with that many bubbles or fewer, e.g. 2 for a complaints feed across a restaurant group ("negative reviews only"), 3 to include the middling ones. Filtered reviews are never billed; the pages are still read. Applied to the reviews read under maxReviewsPerLocation, so use 0 or a sinceDate for a complete list of negative reviews.

tripTypes.title: Trip types
tripTypes.description: Keep only reviews from these trip types, e.g. ["family"] or ["couples", "friends"]; allowed: family, couples, solo, business, friends. Empty (default) = all. Filtered reviews are never billed. TripAdvisor no longer publishes a meal type (breakfast/lunch/dinner), so trip type is the visit context it does carry.

languages.title: Review languages
languages.description: Availability: the zh site failed live checks on 2026-10-16; Chinese collection is currently unverified. Use ["en"] for the tested example. Each language selects a TripAdvisor country site, not a translation target. includeTranslated=false keeps original reviews; filters apply after maxReviewsPerLocation. Each language is a separate job and bill, and translated duplicates can recur across languages. See README for supported site codes.
languages.sectionDescription: Each TripAdvisor country site serves the reviews in its own language, machine translations included.

includeTranslated.title: Include machine-translated reviews
includeTranslated.description: true (default) = keep the machine-translated reviews each site shows (rows carry translated: true and original_language). false = only reviews written in that site's language — with several languages this also stops one review being billed once per language. Use false for "Italian reviews written by Italian diners".

requireText.title: Only reviews with a written text
requireText.description: true = drop rating-only reviews before billing. false (default) = keep them. TripAdvisor reviews almost always carry text, so this rarely removes much.

includeLocationRow.title: Include a location row
includeLocationRow.description: true (default) = also emit one free row per location and language (type "location"): name and type, bubble rating, review count, reviews per rating and per language, food/service/value/atmosphere averages, city ranking ("#12 of 4,870 restaurants in Lisbon"), cuisines, price band, dish tags, category tags, address, coordinates, phone, e-mail, website, menu link, opening hours, open-now and permanently-closed flags. Never charged. false = review and status rows only.

sessions.title: Parallel sessions
sessions.description: Residential proxy sessions (egress IPs) reading in parallel, 1 to 16, e.g. 4 (default 2). More is faster for many locations; each session is paced separately. Does not change the bill.
sessions.sectionDescription: Leave these alone unless a run is being throttled.

perIp.title: Requests per second per session
perIp.description: Requests per second per session, 0.1 to 3 (default 1). TripAdvisor serves about 1 page per second per IP; raising it causes IP rotations, not speed. Leave the default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Keep the default: Apify Proxy, RESIDENTIAL group ({"useApifyProxy": true, "apifyProxyGroups": ["RESIDENTIAL"]}). TripAdvisor's bot gate refuses every datacenter IP, so any other proxy fails every page before anything is charged.

description: TripAdvisor restaurant reviews. Minimal input: {"restaurantNames": ["Cervejaria Ramiro, Lisbon"]} — or startUrls / locationIds; attractions work the same way (locationType "any"). Default = the newest 100 English reviews per location at $0.005 each (at most $0.50 per location) plus a free location row. maxReviewsPerLocation 0 = every review; sinceDate = new reviews only; maxRating 2 = complaints only (filtered reviews are free). Hotel URLs and ids are refused free of charge: use kestrel/tripadvisor-reviews-scraper.
